about: Row-template derivations (COLUMN-3, COLUMN-4, ROW-6, WINDOW-3, EXPR-9, FORMULA-23, LOOKUP-10). A template's derivations run in dependency order whatever order they are written in; each template keeps its own filtered windows and chained passes; a first_available reads a window its template completes first; a grouped template's case reads group keys and converted reductions; a grouped numeric reduction checks clean over a text field, skips its missing values and refuses a present one in the run; a grouped case predicate cannot read an ungrouped driver field, nor a template filter its own window; a column key's window spans every template beside a named intermediate; a keyed input's column joins grouped rows and refuses a repeated key; a case branch fills a template from a first_available column; stored drivers group in their own schemas under a global window; a filter promotes the column defaults it reads; and a grouped filter reads completed windows. Moved from execution_retired_odm_context.rs, its row_derivations module. The sections document is the specification its tests built with their helper, whose output columns, extra columns and row templates each case sets by one edit. A test that saved is a save case with the bytes it compared, one whose save failed states that it saved nothing, and one that checked the specification first is a check case beside it, which writes the files of the test's first check. A test that compared some fields of the issues names them in compares. Every value is its test's.

documents.grouped_sum:
yamaa: "1.0"
type: spec
domain: TEST
keys: [ID]
input: {SRC: {path: input.csv, types: {V: str}}}
output: {path: output.csv, columns: [ID, VALUE]}
columns: [{name: ID, type: str}, {name: VALUE, type: float}]
rows:
  - id: groups
    group_by: [SRC.ID]
    derivations:
      ID: SRC.ID
      VALUE: {aggregate: 'SUM(SRC.V)'}

edits.to: columns: [ID, SECTION, VALUE, PICK, DAY, TEXT]}
columns: [ID, SECTION, VALUE, SEQ, DOUBLE, NEXT]}

rows:
  - id: one
    filter: VALUE > 0
    derivations:
      SECTION: "'one'"
      VALUE: SRC.I
      SEQ: {row_number: {window: {order_by: [VALUE]}}}
      DOUBLE: 'SEQ * 2'
      NEXT: {row_value: {source: DOUBLE, offset: 1, window: {order_by: [SEQ]}}}
  - id: two
    filter: VALUE > 1
    derivations:
      SECTION: "'two'"
      VALUE: SRC.I
      SEQ: {row_number: {window: {order_by: [VALUE]}}}
      DOUBLE: 'SEQ * 2'
      NEXT: {row_value: {source: DOUBLE, offset: 1, window: {order_by: [SEQ]}}}

    derivations:
